title: Stuck Cursed: Dark Fantasy UI Kit
desc: A complete dark fantasy and gothic maritime UI framework for Unity. Features ornate brass borders, responsive modal systems, animated compasses, health bars, and inventory grids.
details: Engineered for RPGs, action games, and atmospheric maritime adventures. Includes 40+ handcrafted sprites, 9-sliced sliced frames, responsive canvas prefabs, animated buttons, sound effect synthesizers, and sample scene layouts ready to drop into any Unity pipeline.

title: Corsair Vehicular Combat Controller
desc: High-octane arcade vehicle controller with dynamic wheel suspension, drift physics, projectile ballistic trajectories, and multiplayer synchronization hooks.
details: Derived from the core combat mechanics of WRX Battles Online. Delivers instant plug-and-play vehicle prefabs, customizable torque curves, tire slip friction models, surface deformation sound triggers, and destructible armor component scripts.

title: Abyssal Dynamic Buoyancy & Ocean Shader
desc: Photorealistic stormy ocean wave shader with GPU Gerstner wave displacement, dynamic crest foam, underwater caustics, and multi-point vessel buoyancy physics.
details: Offers customizable wave amplitude, storm wind velocity, shoreline wave breaking, and synchronous CPU/GPU mathematical ocean height queries so vessels bob and crest realistically in stormy water.

title: Guardian Client Security & Anti-Cheat Kit
desc: Lightweight memory obfuscation, speedhack detection, and tamper-resistant save encryption for standalone Unity games.
details: Prevents unauthorized runtime memory modification, cheat engine variable scraping, save file manipulation, and MITM packet injection on client devices.
